description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed prompts for medical exam MCQs, including instructions, question templates, and validation prompts.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating a medical MCQ based on difficulty, context, and image context, including instructions, question format, and explanation guidelines.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and scenario realism.
